title: Specialist - Information Security
description:
**Job Title**

Specialist - Information Security

**Team description**
--------------------

“Security Middleware” is one of the teams contributing to the security of the Amadeus cloud platform. The team brings together security specialists, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), software developers and network engineers across NCE, Erding and Bangalore.

Together, the team develops, maintains and evolves middleware software and tools used by other divisions. Our organization (TSI-PFS-CFS) is responsible for building the cloud platform foundation used by Amadeus applications.

Security Middleware participates in the Security Solutions Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) train and forms the virtual “Secrets, Keys and Certificates Management” team.

  

As a DevSecOps specialist, you'll work with cybersecurity, cloud and automation technologies, including:

* Cryptographic and key management: CryptoManager interfaces applications with Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), while Sekhmet supports point-to-point client authentication.
* Secret management: CyberArk Daemon and Secret Operator support secret management across Microsoft Azure Key Vault and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Secret Manager.
* Certificate management: Venafi supports certificate lifecycle management and interacts with Amadeus' production Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and trusted Certificate Authorities (CAs).
* Encryption: You'll contribute to capabilities supporting encryption at rest and in transit.
Automation and self-service: Terraform and Kratix support automation and self-service capabilities across these components.  

  

**Summary of the position**
---------------------------

As Amadeus continues its cloud migration, you'll help address evolving security requirements across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud. You'll contribute to secure, resilient cloud capabilities while developing your expertise across cybersecurity, automation, secret management, certificate management and cryptographic technologies.

As part of the team, you'll contribute to:

* Improving platform security across Microsoft Azure and GCP while helping maintain reliable and resilient services.
* Strengthening and simplifying security solutions while supporting compliance requirements, including components subject to Payment Card Industry (PCI) audits.
* Developing self-service capabilities for GCP secret management and certificate management.
* Developing key-management capabilities and improving crypto-agility, including Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate management on F5 technologies.
* Working with teams across locations to improve security automation and operational sustainability.

In the SMW/SKC team, you'll have opportunities to develop your knowledge of multi-cloud security and automation. You'll work across locations and collaborate with other teams, Security Train colleagues and automation specialists while taking responsibility for agreed activities and learning relevant technologies.

  

**Main expectations**
---------------------

* Cybersecurity and engineering: Relevant experience in information technology engineering, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, or a related area, with an understanding of security principles and operational sustainability.
* Software development and automation: Experience with technologies such as C++, Python, Unix, Shell, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible or Kratix, with the ability to contribute to system administration and automation activities.
* Cloud and containers: Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes or Docker and an interest in applying security practices within cloud environments.
* Technical problem solving: Ability to investigate technical issues, contribute to technical initiatives and continue developing knowledge of relevant technologies. Familiarity with the Scaled Agile Framework can support collaboration with the team's existing delivery model.
Collaboration: Ability to work independently when appropriate and collaborate effectively with colleagues across teams, disciplines, cultures and locations.  

  

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
* A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
* Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities and daily interactions.
* A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
* A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits.
* A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
* A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.  

  

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.

In addition to this, we also have Regional Engagement Hubs across India and a co-working space in Bangalore.

**Organizational Overview:** This role will be part of Synchrony Identity and Access Management Technology and Governance team which ties to Synchrony Information Security team.

**Role Summary/Purpose:** The Identity Governance User Reconciliation Senior Analyst is responsible for the validation of access between Synchrony systems and Synchrony’s identity governance platform. Synchrony leverages SailPoint Identity IQ for its identity governance platform. An access reconciliation portal was created to reconcile access and role data between SailPoint Identity IQ and the target Synchrony system. This role will have the responsibility to ensure all access and role information in Synchrony’s identity governance platform matches exactly with the respective access in each Synchrony system. This role will be a critical member of Synchrony’s identity governance configuration management agile product team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Ensure access and role information in Synchrony’s identity governance platform matches with the access information in the respective Synchrony system.
* Ensure roles and privileges that exist in the target system have an IT Role in Synchrony’s identity governance platform.

* Work with Synchrony’s Role Based Access Control (RBAC) team to have IT Roles created for any roles that exist in the target system, but not in Synchrony’s identity governance platform.
* All role and access discrepancies must be remediated with the help of the technology owner and Synchrony’s security administration team. Any remaining discrepancies must certified outside Synchrony’s identity governance platform and appropriately risk treated.
* For any systems that are not onboarded onto the access reconciliation portal, a manual reconciliation of access must be performed in accordance to the published job aid.
* Partner with technology owners, the IAM security administration team and the access reconciliation portal development team to ensure accurate and complete role and workgroup configurations.
* Ensure all access reconciliation job aids and end user guides are accurate, maintained and effectively communicated regularly.
* Actively participate as a critical member of the SIAM Configuration Management agile product team. Develop, prioritize and ensure timely execution of all agile stories as assigned by the VP, Identity Governance Configuration Process.
* Provide training and education to technology owners and stakeholders on access management best practices and standards.
* Identify, propose and remediate process and technical gaps in Synchrony’s access reconciliation service.

**Required Skills/Knowledge :**

* 2 – 4 years of information technology (IT) experience with at least 2 years of experience in the Identity Access Management (IAM) domain.
* Minimum 2 years of role administration experience within SailPoint IdentityIQ.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge :**

* Working knowledge of Jira and SAFE agile framework
* Working knowledge of entitlements and IT roles.
* Working experience managing ServiceNow requests and incidents, resolving tickets within SLA.
* Proven strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and Excel
* Knowledge of security related regulatory standards including HIPAA, PCI, SOX, NIST
* Good understanding of AWS and O365 environments
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database and SQL.

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 2 to 4 years of relevant IT work experience of information technology (IT) experience with at least 2 years of experience in the Identity Access Management (IAM) domain.

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). description:
**ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across ACC’s Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation – including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness – and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle’s quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes.

**Primary Role – Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems**

  

* Own the overall test strategy, test plans and testing approach for the Oracle Fusion Cloud program, covering Financials modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement
* Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements.
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers.
* Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting.
* Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle.
* Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting.
* Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure.
* Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle’s quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions.
* Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program’s defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest.
* Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards.
* Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change.
* Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team.
* Produce clear and timely test status reporting, including execution progress, pass and fail rates, open defects by severity, and risks to the delivery schedule, for project leadership and stakeholders.
* Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle
* Lead, mentor and coordinate a team of QA engineers, including work allocation, estimation, daily prioritization and review of test cases, scripts and evidence for quality and completeness.
* Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles.
* Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program.
* Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11:00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods.daily.Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required.

  

* undefined
* Minimum of eight years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least four years testing enterprise ERP applications and at least two years leading a QA team, is required.
* undefinedLead and manage a small to mid-sized QA team (2–5 engineers), including task allocation, daily progress tracking, deliverable reviews, mentoring and onboarding of new team members.Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred. Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required. Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred. Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required.

  

* Familiarity with Oracle’s quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred.

  

* Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage.

  

* Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred.

  

* ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus .

  

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel.

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely.

  

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders.

  

* Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision.

Drive the investigation, containment, remediation, documentation and lessons learned for security events, with timely escalation of material risk and business impact.

Establish quality controls for team output, including peer review, evidence retention, ticket hygiene, runbooks and repeatable operating procedures.

This role is responsible for ensuring proper settlement of domestic and foreign securities and derivative trades executed in EAICA's general account, managed separate accounts, and the Empower Capital Funds. Supports the team staff to complete their tasks by providing coverage or helping create processes to mitigate risk and increase efficiency.

  
  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

* Ensure internally executed trades flow properly from the Trading System to the Accounting system.
* Confirm trades with counterparties. Notify custodian banks of pending trade settlement and ensure that trades settle properly. Trade responsibilities may include the more complex transactions such as processing and tracking TBA's & dollar rolls.
* Maintain, troubleshoot and support the trading system (Bloomberg AIM/CTM) as the departments subject matter expert
* Enter daily trade activity, including subadvised trades, into the accounting system. Trade activity includes but is not limited to domestic and foreign securities trades and exchange traded and OTC derivatives.
* Perform team support role, including process improvement, testing system upgrades and enhancements, developing trade messages for accounting system, and working with outside vendors for sub advised trade loads.
* Review trades and security setups from the team, to ensure accurate processing.
* Process swap payments, communicating and confirming payment details with counterparties prior to settlement.
* Fund new private placements, communicating with EAICA's traders and legal group.
* Coordinate and process forward foreign currency contract settlements with multiple counterparties.
* Support the Manager, Settlements with resolving complex trade settlement issues, assisting in training new personnel and taking on additional duties as assigned.
  

  

QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. (accounting preferred) Other Preferred

**About Reward360**
===================

Reward360 is India's premier **loyalty rewards and e-commerce platform manager**, delivering cutting-edge transaction and engagement solutions to global banks, brands, and enterprise clients. As we scale our ecosystem to process millions of transactions securely, we are expanding our cybersecurity defense. We are seeking a proactive and technically proficient **SOC Analyst (L2)** to join our Security Operations Center and safeguard our digital infrastructure against emerging cyber threats, fraud vectors, and account takeovers.

=========================

* **Incident Triage & Response:** Validate, investigate, and escalate critical security alerts. Correlate data across complex enterprise infrastructures, cloud environments, and transactional applications.
* **Log & Metric Monitoring:** Provide continuous analysis and trending of security log data from heterogeneous infrastructure components including SIEM, firewalls, and cloud access proxies.
* **Threat & Vulnerability Management:** Conduct deep-dive analysis of threat vectors and active indicators of compromise (IoCs). Respond effectively to zero-day vulnerabilities.
* **Security Content Creation:** Construct SIEM content (e.g., active filters, custom correlation rules, dashboards, and situational alerts) to enhance detection mechanisms.
* **Collaborative Investigation:** Investigate, document, and report on emerging threat trends. Partner with Tier-1 analysts, engineering teams, and threat intelligence groups to ensure swift containment.
* **24x7 Operations:** Operate effectively within a **24x7 rotating Security Operations Centre (SOC) shift environment** to maintain uninterrupted organizational security posture.

  

**Technical Qualifications & Skills**
=====================================

**Education & Professional Certifications**

* **Degree:** BE / B.Tech / M.Tech / MSc / MCA qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or an equivalent field.
* **Certifications (At least one preferred):** CEH, CISSP, GCFE, GCFA, CCNP Security, CCIE Security, or equivalent cybersecurity credentials.

  

**Required Domain Experience**

* **Cybersecurity Focus:** Minimum **3 years of overall cybersecurity experience**, with at least **2 years dedicated exclusively to a fast-paced SOC environment**.
* **Tools Expertise:** Proficiency with industry-standard SIEM platforms (e.g., Crowdstrike, SentinleOne, Wazuh,ELK Stack ) alongside core tools like HIPS/NIPS, Packet Analysis (Wireshark), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Web Application Firewalls (WAF).
* **Ticketing & Workflows:** Practical exposure to enterprise ticketing suites such as **ServiceNow** or **Remedy** for incident lifestyle tracking.

* **Scripting:** Basic hands-on automation or analysis scripting capability using languages like **Python**, bash,or Go.

**Soft Skills & Workplace Attributes**
======================================

* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with the capability to draft crisp, analytical visual threat summaries and technical incident response briefs for diverse engineering stakeholders.
* **Problem-Solving:** An analytical mindset focused on dissecting attack methodologies, finding root causes, and formulating defensive strategies.

**T&T-Customer - CS&D - | Financial Services PM/BA| Delhi Senior Consultant**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 116171
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Customer is about much more than just the numbers. It’s about attesting to accomplishments and challenges and helping to assure strong foundations for future aspirations. Deloitte exemplifies the what, how, and why of change so you’re always ready to act ahead. Learn more about Customer

  

**Your work profile**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented **Business Analyst / Project Manager (BA/PM) Hybrid** to join our Market Security Services (MSS) team. This role sits at the intersection of business operations and technology, with a primary concentration on business analysis and a complementary focus on project management. You will specialize in the MSS domain—specifically targeting **Accounts, SSIs, Books, Hierarchy, and Pricing**. The successful candidate will bridge the gap between stakeholders and technical teams to drive process improvements, implement system enhancements, and ensure the integrity of our security data, financial workflows, and account structures.

  

**1. Business Analysis & Requirement Engineering (Core Focus)**

* **Domain Expertise:** Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Market Security Services, specifically focusing on Accounts management, Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI), Books architecture, Account Hierarchy, and Pricing models.
* **Requirement Gathering:** Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document complex business requirements for post-trade and static data systems.
* **Documentation:** Create high-quality business requirement documents (BRD), functional specification documents (FSD), user stories, and process flow diagrams (UML/BPMN).
* **Gap Analysis:** Perform detailed gap analysis between current "As-Is" processes and desired "To-Be" states to identify automation opportunities in data setup and trade routing.

**2. Domain-Specific Focus Areas**

* **Accounts & Hierarchy:** Streamline the onboarding and management of client/entity accounts, ensuring robust parent-child account hierarchy models and internal "Books" mapping for accurate downstream reporting.
* **Standard Settlement Instructions (SSI):** Oversee the automation and maintenance of SSIs across custody and clearing networks to mitigate settlement risk and reduce trade fail rates.
* **Pricing & Valuation:** Collaborate with pricing desks and market data vendors to implement or refine instrument valuation models, ensuring the integrity of real-time price feeds, corporate action adjustments, and end-of-day valuations.

**3. Project Management (Adaptive Focus)**

* **Lifecycle Management:** Coordinate project phases through the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile, Scrum, or Hybrid methodologies.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary point of contact for business heads, technology teams, and external vendors to align operational priorities.
* **Delivery & Tracking:** Define project scope, create detailed project plans, manage timelines, track sprints, and mitigate risks/impediments to ensure on-time delivery.

**4. Testing & Quality Assurance**

* **User Acceptance Testing (UAT):** Lead the design, execution, and sign-off of UAT scripts, ensuring that system enhancements meet complex business logic and regulatory requirements.
* **Defect Management:** Collaborate with QA teams to prioritize, track, and resolve system defects during the testing phase.
  

**Key Skills Required :**

  

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in a Business Analyst role with progressive project coordination responsibilities within Investment Banking, Asset Management, or Securities Services.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep understanding of the post-trade lifecycle, settlement processes, instrument master data, account hierarchy structures, internal book mappings, and security pricing.
* **Tools:** Proficiency in agile project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) and visual modeling software (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart).
* **Data Analysis:** Strong ability to write SQL queries and manipulate complex data structures in Excel to support data profiling and business logic validation.

**Soft Skills:**

* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical and operational roadmaps to senior leadership.
* **Problem-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in financial workflows and proposing scalable architecture solutions.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to balance deep-dive business analysis with project delivery timelines in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

**Education & Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* CBAP, CSPO, CSM, PMP, or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

title: Quantitative Engineer - Associate
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Summary**:

The Tax-Advantaged Equity (TAE) team is seeking to enhance its investment platform, analytics, and portfolio management capabilities by adding a partner focused on developing scalable technology and data-driven solutions that support portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and investment professionals.

This role will focus on building and modernizing investment applications, analytics platforms, workflow tools, and data pipelines that support tax-managed equity strategies, portfolio construction, tax-loss harvesting, investment analytics, and portfolio management processes.

The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering and cloud development expertise with an understanding of investment management workflows. This individual will work closely with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and analytics teams to design and deliver modern applications and scalable platforms that improve investment decision-making, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.

This role is central to advancing the TAE technology platform by embedding modern engineering practices, cloud-native solutions, and data analytics capabilities into the investment process.

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the Tax-Advantaged Equity team to design, develop, and maintain investment technology platforms supporting portfolio management, tax optimization, investment analytics, and research workflows.
* Build modern web applications and dashboards using .NET, C#, and cloud-native technologies to provide portfolio managers and researchers with intuitive access to investment insights and workflow tools.
* Develop scalable APIs, services, and application frameworks that support portfolio construction, tax-loss harvesting, portfolio monitoring, and investment reporting capabilities.
* Design and maintain cloud-based data pipelines that aggregate, normalize, and distribute investment, benchmark, portfolio, holdings, transaction, and market data for research and production use cases.
* Leverage Azure Cloud technologies to build resilient, secure, and scalable solutions that support the investment lifecycle.
* Develop Python-based analytics and automation tools that improve research productivity, portfolio analytics, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers and portfolio managers to implement new investment models, portfolio optimization techniques, and analytical capabilities.
* Improve application performance, scalability, and reliability by applying software engineering best practices, testing frameworks, and CI/CD processes.
* Work with cross-functional teams across Investments, Technology, Data Engineering, and Analytics to ensure technology solutions align with business objectives.
* Identify innovative solutions to complex business and technical challenges and advocate for their implementation through effective communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Engage with business stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure successful delivery of technology solutions.
* Work within established development, security, governance, and risk management standards.

**Knowledge/Skills:**

* Strong software engineering and application development experience, preferably within financial services or investment management.
* Experience building enterprise applications using.NET and C#.
* Understanding of Azure Cloud, cloud-native architectures, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Experience developing data-driven solutions and analytics platforms using Python.
* Familiarity with investment management concepts including Equities, Portfolio Construction, Tax-managed investing, Portfolio analytics, Risk management and Investment workflows.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, DevOps practices, and modern engineering principles.
* Ability to connect technology solutions with business outcomes in an investment management environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, investment analysts, and technology partners.
* Experience with relational databases, SQL, and data modeling.
* Familiarity with modern web application architectures and API development.

**Experience Required:**

* 1-4 years of experience in software engineering, quantitative engineering, investment technology, or data engineering.
* Strong proficiency in C# .NET, React, Python and SQL.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, Azure Storage, Azure SQL or equivalent cloud services.
* Experience building APIs, enterprise applications, dashboards, and cloud-based solutions.
* Exposure to investment management, asset management, or financial services is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
* CFA designation or progress toward CFA is a plus.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Associate InfoSec Engineer
description:
**Associate Information Security Engineer**

**Company:** Reward360 Global Services Private Limited

**Location:** **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**

**Experience:** **1–2 years**

**Department:** Information Security / Engineering

  

**Job Overview**

As an **Associate Information Security Engineer** at Reward360, you will be a vital part of our offensive and defensive security operations. You will focus on simulating real-world cyberattacks, identifying vulnerabilities within our core loyalty platforms, and collaborating directly with development teams to ensure a resilient infrastructure. This is an ideal role for an ambitious professional looking to bridge the gap between application security, cloud penetration testing, and secure code review.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Offensive Security & Pentesting:** Conduct **White-Box and Grey-Box penetration testing** across internally developed web applications, microservices, APIs, and cloud infrastructure with AI approach.
* **Vulnerability Assessment:** Utilize manual exploitation techniques alongside automated tooling to detect flaws, API security gaps, and misconfigurations before they reach production.
* **Secure Code Review:** Analyze source code manually and leverage
* **SAST/DAST utilities** to identify logical, cryptographic, and injection vulnerabilities.
* **Remediation & Mitigation:** Collaborate with product managers and product development software engineers to provide actionable triage, remediation guidance, and verification re-testing.
* **CI/CD Integration:** Assist in scaling security controls and guardrails by promoting automated security checks within the active DevOps pipelines.
* **Threat Modeling:** Assist with early-lifecycle threat modeling to architect secure and low-risk software deployments.Followed by STRIDE,PASTA,and MAESTRO,

  
  

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* **Technical Capabilities & Frameworks**
  + Comprehensive understanding of web and API security standards, specifically the **OWASP Top 10** and OWASP API Security methodologies.
  + Practical familiarity with foundational penetration testing frameworks such as **PTES, OSSTMM, or NIST**.
  + Exposure to cloud computing security fundamentals, with a strong emphasis on **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** environments.
  Hands-on knowledge in EKS and ECS Security

  

* **Security Infrastructure & Tooling**
  + Hands-on familiarity with penetration testing operating systems like **Kali Linux** or **Parrot OS**.
  + Everyday capability with interception proxies and security scanners, including **Burp Suite, Caido, Nessus**
  + Ability to script basic automation utilities using programming languages like **Python or JavaScript**.

  

* **Education & Certifications (Preferred)**
  + **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
  + **Certifications (Good to have):** CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)/CRTP/CPTS

title: Associate Analyst-RMS Personal Independence-GMS
description:
Location: Gurgaon

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: 23 Oct 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752103

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Career Family**

Risk Management Service

  

**Role Type**

Associate Analyst/ Analyst

  

**Competency**

Independence Risk Management Enablement Group - Global Monitoring System (GMS) Process

  

**Associate Analyst / Analyst - Independence - Risk Management Services**

This role requires the candidate to conduct research and execute global Independence processes aligned with EY Global (EYG) policies. These processes aim to safeguard EY's independence by assisting professionals in complying with the firm's personal Independence policies. The candidate will monitor professionals' financial relationships to identify and report potential conflicts of interest with audit clients. Additionally, this role involves providing coordinated support to EY professionals by answering their inquiries and questions on various country and personal Independence-related topics

  

**The opportunity**

Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.

  

This role will be part of the largest sub-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and mitigating any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditor's independence. This includes assessing employee financial and personal relationships, conducting investigations, providing guidance on resolving personal independence matters, and monitoring for new independence threats.

  

RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centers’: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.

  

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to EY's reputation as an independent auditor by supporting niche Independence profiles within a dynamic and growing environment. You'll work closely with EY professionals to mitigate their personal independence-related risks. This will involve collaborating with senior team members and stakeholders to resolve queries and gather information, ultimately positioning you as a subject matter expert in Independence processes.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

An Associate Analyst/ Analyst in the GMS team, will be responsible for developing a working knowledge of Personal Independence concepts, including financial interests, family relations, and business relationships. You will execute procedures as outlined in the EYG Independence policies, conduct research, and make updates to various EY tools and databases used to monitor their family and financial relationships (like securities, loans, insurance policies, etc). Through these activities, you will contribute to helping EY Professionals mitigate independence-related risks. In this role, you will communicate with EY professionals and senior team members to resolve queries and gather information, while learning from experienced professionals to become proficient in Independence processes.

  

**Technical expertise**

* Build good understanding of financial products and markets, such as equities, structured products, and funds, while executing work requests & projects from initiation to completion in line with established procedures.
* Perform research and analysis on EY professionals' financial interests and family relationships, including brokerage accounts, loans, and insurance policies, to determine the permissibility of their investments
* Participate in wide range of projects and collaborate with project managers for timely completion of assigned work
* Take part in team discussions/activities, service functions/ organization wide initiatives
* Understand and work towards meeting and exceeding the defined individual KPIs for the role.
* Build working knowledge of different internal Independence tools used to record EY professionals financial and family relation data such as details of securities owned and controlled, broker and deposit accounts, business relationships, loans, insurance policies etc.
* Candidate needs to be diligent and hardworking and be highly motivated, result oriented, with a strong willingness to learn quickly.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Possess strong communication and inter-personal skills.
* Fostering a diverse and inclusive team environment by actively participating in team events and engagements
* Must possess a client- centric and enablement mindset
* Prioritize tasks and manage time effectively to meet business expectations without compromising on quality or deadlines.
* Uphold the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and values.
* Be adaptable and agile in dynamic situations, facilitating change management.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Masters/post-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in research and analysis in a professional services firm
* Well-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Basic understanding of financial products like equities, mutual funds, pension plans, insurance policies etc.

  

**Technologies and Tools**

* Experience in MS office suites like Outlook, MS excel, Word, SharePoint etc.

  

**What you can look for**

* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team that runs on foundational values of trust, respect, integrity and teaming.
* A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with Global teams and stakeholders
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Goldman Sachs Private Bank**

Goldman Sachs Private Bank provides competitive borrowing and cash management solutions from Goldman Sachs Bank USA that are strategically integrated with our client’s wealth management goals. Our experienced team partners with PWAs to advise clients on new loans, refinancing and restructuring of existing loans along with overall liability management. Our lenders and mortgage specialists provide a wide range of creative borrowing solutions against asset classes ranging from marketable securities and alternative investments, residential and commercial real estate to more tailored solutions against private assets such as aviation, fine art or vineyards. All team members are employees of Goldman Sachs Bank, USA

  

**Private Lending Underwriting**

Private Lending Underwriting (PLU), based in Bengaluru, is primarily responsible for the underwriting of loans to GS Private Wealth Management (PWM) clients. In this capacity, PLU assesses, underwrites, documents, and monitors the credit and business risks incurred in loan transactions. The underwriting process includes a thorough analysis of the borrower’s financial condition, assessment of any collateral securing the loan, identification of risks and mitigants, among other items. Types of loans underwritten include commercial real estate, GS and third-party private equity/hedge funds (including co-invest facilities), aircraft, fine art, hobby properties, private company stock, yachts, marketable securities, etc.
  
PLU also ensures that the underwriting standards approved by the bank are adhered to in the loan approval process, with exceptions appropriately mitigated and documented. In addition, PLU participates in various business-related initiatives, such as new product development and systems/operational enhancements.
  
Private Lending is a part of GS Private Bank (PB), which is a business initiative of Goldman Sachs. PLU employees are employees of Goldman Sachs Bank USA.

* Evaluate all risk and economic implications of transactions, using strong analytical and technical skills
* Work closely with the Regional Lending and Underwriting Team to conduct periodical review of client’s financial position & collateral performance and assess if they remain within acceptable risk parameters for the Bank
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the product suite offered in Private Lending. Ensure consistency in the underwriting and review process and with the standards prescribed in the Product Lending Guides

* Interact with banking regulators on an as needed basis. Provide other support of GS Bank USA’s loan portfolio as requested
* Foster strong communication with Regional Underwriting and Private Lending teams, Credit Risk Management, PWM teams, clients and GS Bank USA personnel

* CA Fresher or experienced

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Security Engineer to join Deltek’s growing AI Center of Excellence team to design, build, and operate the security, compliance, guardrail, and policy controls that keep our internal Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions safe, trustworthy, and production-ready. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AI security, application and cloud security, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), SLMs, and software engineering with a practical understanding of MLOps/LLMOps to secure AI applications without slowing the teams that build them. This role reports to the Senior AI Solutions Architect.

Key Responsibilities

AI Security & Threat Defense

* Design and implement security architecture and controls for LLM, Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI applications.

* Perform threat modeling and AI-specific risk assessments aligned to frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF.

* Defend against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, model and data poisoning, insecure output handling, and excessive agent autonomy.

* Conduct AI red teaming, adversarial testing, and penetration testing of models, prompts, agents, and integrations; track findings through remediation.

* Secure MCP servers, agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, tool calling, and plugin integrations with least-privilege access, authentication, and authorization.

* Protect models, embeddings, vector stores, prompts, and training data with encryption, access controls, secrets management, and network isolation.

AI Guardrails & Runtime Protection

* Design, implement, and tune guardrails for input and output filtering, content safety, topic restrictions, grounding checks, and hallucination mitigation.

* Build and operate PII, sensitive data, and secrets detection and redaction across prompts, retrieved context, and model responses.

* Evaluate and integrate guardrail tooling such as AWS Bedrock Guardrails, Azure AI Content Safety, NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, and LLM Guard.

* Build automated safety, security, and bias evaluation suites and run them as quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.

title: Web Application Security Engineer | WAF
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced WAF & Application Security Subject Matter Expert (SME) to strengthen web application and API security across multiple applications and platforms. The role focuses on WAF engineering, advanced rule development, efficacy testing, policy tuning, false-positive mitigation, and security posture enhancement.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with at least three major WAF vendors, a strong background in SOC/CSIRT, Application Security (AppSec), or Ethical Hacking, and expertise in web attack analysis, security automation, and DevSecOps. The candidate will play a key role in identifying security gaps, mitigating attack evasions, developing custom protection rules, and integrating automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and implement custom WAF rules and security features to address vulnerabilities, security gaps, and baseline compliance requirements.
* Evaluate WAF rulesets, features, and configurations to maximize the detection and mitigation of web-based and API-based attacks.
* Develop and execute efficacy testing for baseline policies, custom rules, WAF Proofs of Concept (PoCs), new features, and security solutions.
* Integrate automated WAF testing and security validation into CI/CD pipelines to support DevSecOps initiatives.
* Monitor and review WAF tuning requests, conduct detailed log analysis, identify false positives, and recommend appropriate policy adjustments.
* Analyze web traffic, attack payloads, and security events to identify evasion techniques and develop effective mitigation strategies.
* Perform reverse engineering of attack payloads and exploits, where required, to strengthen WAF protection.
* Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot WAF policies, signatures, access controls, rate limiting, bot mitigation, and virtual patching.
* Provide SME guidance on web and API attack methodologies, application security, WAF architecture, and mitigation techniques.
* Support WAF migrations, upgrades, policy rollouts, production deployments, and security solution assessments.
* Collaborate with SOC/CSIRT, AppSec, DevSecOps, infrastructure, network, and application development teams to integrate security solutions.
* Conduct regular WAF configuration reviews and security assessments to ensure compliance with security baselines and industry best practices.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation covering WAF configurations, tuning procedures, policies, test cases, and operational standards.
* Stay updated on emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, security threats, and WAF technologies to continuously improve security effectiveness.

Must-Have Skills

* Extensive hands-on experience in WAF implementation, engineering, configuration, administration, tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Practical experience with at least three major WAF vendors, such as F5 Advanced WAF/ASM, Akamai, AWS WAF, Cloudflare, Imperva, or Azure WAF.
* Strong knowledge of web application security, API security, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, HTTP headers, cookies, sessions, reverse proxies, and load balancers.
* Expertise in identifying and mitigating SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Remote Code Execution (RCE), API attacks, and WAF evasion techniques.
* Proven experience in custom WAF rule development, security policy optimization, signature management, and false-positive analysis.
* Strong background in SOC/CSIRT, Application Security, Ethical Hacking, penetration testing, or security incident investigation.
* Hands-on experience with log analysis and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Wireshark, or custom scripts.
* Experience designing and executing WAF efficacy tests and validating security controls against attack scenarios.
* Practical knowledge of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and security testing integration.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with cloud application security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, secure coding principles, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON traffic inspection, API protection, bot mitigation, and rate limiting.
* Familiarity with VAPT, penetration testing, vulnerability management, virtual patching, and remediation validation.
* Experience in WAF architecture design, migrations, upgrades, enterprise-wide policy rollouts, and production deployments.
* Knowledge of incident response, threat hunting, root-cause analysis, and SIEM integration.
* Experience developing automation scripts using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
* Familiarity with security compliance standards such as PCI DSS and ISO 27001.
* Ability to provide technical guidance to application teams and collaborate with security, network, infrastructure, and development stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex security concepts to technical and non-technical teams.

Education

Job Title: Service Desk Operations & Governance SME  
Position: Associate Consultant
  
Experience: 6+ Years  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering  
Main location: Bangalore  
Job Code: J0826-2154  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Job Description:
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Service Desk professional with strong operational and ITIL expertise to take ownership of the day-to-day operational governance of a multilingual Service Desk environment.  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that Service Desk operations are structured, measurable, governed and continuously improved. The individual will analyse operational performance, identify recurring issues and service gaps, drive corrective actions, ensure adherence to agreed processes and coordinate with L2/L3 teams to improve resolution outcomes.  
The role is not limited to managing people or monitoring queues. The successful candidate will act as a Service Desk subject-matter expert and operational governance owner, bringing structure, discipline and analytical insight into the operation.  
The role will work closely with the Service Delivery Manager, Service Desk Leads, L2/L3 resolver teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, workplace/EUS teams, vendors and client stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Service Desk Operational Governance  

* Own the day-to-day operational governance of the Service Desk.
* Establish and maintain operational routines covering:

o Daily operational review  
o SLA performance  
o Backlog  
o Aging tickets  
o Priority incidents  
o Reassignments  
o Escalations  
o Abandoned/unanswered calls  
o Ticket quality  
o Customer feedback  

* Ensure operational teams follow agreed processes, SOPs and ITIL practices.
* Identify deviations from the operating model and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate ownership and accountability across the Service Desk.
* Maintain operational readiness for changes, new services and project transitions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
2. Performance & Data Analysis  
This should be one of the core responsibilities of the role.  

* Analyse Service Desk performance trends and identify underlying causes.
* Monitor and interpret:

o SLA achievement  
o Response and resolution performance  
o Ticket volumes  
o Backlog  
o Aging  
o Reopen rates  
o First Contact Resolution  
o Escalation rates  
o Call abandonment  
o Customer satisfaction  
o Productivity  
o Quality scores  

* Identify trends rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Produce meaningful operational insights and recommendations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and translate them into improvement initiatives.
* Maintain dashboards and management reports.
* Prepare inputs for weekly/monthly service reviews.
* Highlight risks and emerging issues to the SDM before they become escalations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
3. Ticket Hygiene & Quality Management  

* Drive improvement in Service Desk ticket quality and documentation.
* Ensure tickets contain appropriate:

o Categorisation  
o Prioritisation  
o User/business impact  
o Troubleshooting performed  
o Worklogs  
o Resolution details  
o Knowledge references  
o Closure information  

* Perform regular ticket sampling and quality audits.
* Identify recurring quality issues by agent/team/process.
* Work with Team Leads to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure tickets are progressed appropriately and do not remain unnecessarily in queues.
* Identify tickets requiring escalation and ensure timely handover to L2/L3.
* Monitor tickets approaching SLA breach and ensure proactive intervention.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
4. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management  

* Provide operational oversight of Major/P1/P2 incidents from the Service Desk perspective.
* Ensure correct prioritisation and escalation based on business impact.
* Support Major Incident Management and ensure appropriate Service Desk participation.
* Identify recurring incidents and candidates for Problem Management.
* Analyse repeat incidents and identify opportunities for permanent resolution.
* Work with L2/L3 resolver groups to drive recurring-problem reduction.
* Track outstanding actions from major incidents and problem investigations.
* Ensure lessons learned are converted into process, knowledge or technical improvements.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
5. Cross-Functional Coordination  
Act as the operational bridge between Service Desk and resolver teams.  

* Coordinate with L2/L3 Infrastructure, Applications, EUS, IAM, Network, Cloud and other support teams.
* Identify bottlenecks in the incident/request resolution lifecycle.
* Challenge unnecessary ticket transfers and ownership gaps.
* Ensure clear escalation paths are followed.
* Drive resolution of aged or stuck tickets across resolver groups.
* Identify recurring dependency issues between Service Desk and other support towers.
* Work with application and infrastructure SMEs to improve knowledge available to the Service Desk.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
6. Process & Continual Service Improvement  

* Identify opportunities to streamline Service Desk processes.
* Review existing workflows and identify unnecessary manual steps.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives around:

o Incident management  
o Request fulfilment  
o Knowledge management  
o Escalation  
o Ticket routing  
o Categorisation  
o Automation  
o Self-service  
o Monitoring integration  

* Identify opportunities for automation and shift-left.
* Improve First Contact Resolution through better knowledge, tooling and training.
* Maintain and improve Service Desk SOPs and operational documentation.
* Support implementation of ITIL-aligned practices.
* Ensure improvements are measurable and demonstrate operational/business benefit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
7. Knowledge Management  

* Ensure knowledge articles are available and usable by Service Desk agents.
* Identify knowledge gaps from ticket trends and recurring incidents.
* Work with L2/L3 teams to convert technical resolutions into Service Desk knowledge.
* Review the quality and usefulness of existing knowledge articles.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge Management and shift-left practices.
* Identify opportunities for self-service and automation based on recurring requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
8. Team Coaching & Operational Enablement  
The role should not replace the Team Leads, but should provide SME-level direction and coaching.  

* Coach Team Leads and senior analysts on ITIL processes and operational practices.
* Support agents in improving troubleshooting and ticket-handling quality.
* Identify capability gaps based on operational data.
* Recommend targeted training and coaching.
* Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support onboarding of new Service Desk resources.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
9. Client & Stakeholder Support  
The person will have stakeholder interaction, but the SDM remains the primary client/account owner.  

* Provide operational inputs for client service reviews.
* Prepare factual analysis and recommendations for the SDM.
* Participate in operational governance meetings.
* Support service-related escalations.
* Provide timely updates on operational risks and improvement actions.
* Translate operational data into meaningful business-level insights.
* Support the SDM in preparing service improvement proposals and operational roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
10. Governance & Compliance  

* Ensure adherence to agreed governance frameworks and contractual processes.
* Maintain operational evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL, security and organisational processes.
* Track actions, risks, issues and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain Service Desk operational documentation and control mechanisms.
* Support internal and client audits where required.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
11. Key Deliverables / KPIs  
I would make the role accountable for outcomes, rather than just activities.  
Area Expected Outcome  
SLA Consistent SLA achievement and early intervention on breaches  
Backlog Controlled and continuously improving backlog  
Ticket Aging Reduction of aged/stagnant tickets  
Ticket Quality Improved ticket hygiene and documentation  
FCR Continuous improvement in First Contact Resolution  
CSAT Improvement in customer experience  
Escalations Reduction in avoidable escalations  
Repeat Incidents Identification and reduction of recurring issues  
Quality Consistent quality audit performance  
Process Compliance High adherence to agreed ITIL processes  
Knowledge Increased usage and quality of knowledge articles  
Automation Identification and delivery of automation opportunities  
Continual Improvement Measurable improvement initiatives delivered  
Governance Accurate and timely operational reporting  
  
Mandatory Skills:  

* 6+ years of Service Desk / IT Operations experience, with significant experience in senior/SME/leadership roles.
* Strong experience managing large or complex Service Desk operations.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Incident, Request, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.
* Experience with SLA/KPI management and operational governance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated experience in root-cause analysis and recurring-issue reduction.
* Strong understanding of Service Desk ticket lifecycle and ITSM practices.
* Experience working with L2/L3 resolver teams.
* Experience managing operational escalations.
* Experience in continual service improvement.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience working in a multi-team / multi-vendor IT environment.

Preferred Skills :
  

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* ITIL Managing Professional modules would be an advantage.
* Experience with TopDesk, ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM platforms.
* Experience with multilingual Service Desk operations.
* Experience with Service Desk transformation, automation and shift-left initiatives.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies / Workplace / EUS environments.
* Experience in outsourced IT service delivery / managed services

title: GMS-Staff-IDS Management
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 19, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744116

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Network Security Engineer – IDS/IPS (Staff / Junior Level)**

  

**Experience Level: 1–3 Years**

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Junior to Staff-level Network Security Engineer specializing in Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS). Working closely with senior architects and security operations teams, this individual will support the end-to-end lifecycle of our IDS/IPS sensors—spanning Assess, Build, Transition, and Operations. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in network protocols, traffic analysis, and alert triage, with a keen interest in signature tuning, vulnerability detection, and maintaining high sensor availability across enterprise environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Assess (Posture Review & Signature Evaluation)**

* Assist in evaluating existing network tap/SPAN port configurations and sensor placements to ensure complete visibility across critical network segments.
* Review vendor threat intelligence feeds, CVE releases, and security advisories to assess coverage gaps against emerging network attack vectors.
* Audit current IDS signature sets and inspection policies to identify noisy, legacy, or deprecated rules causing excessive false positives.
* Document sensor hardware/software versions, throughput metrics, and interface utilization to support capacity planning.

**Build (Deployment, Baseline & Integration)**

* Support the installation, initial configuration, and staging of physical and virtual IDS/IPS appliances or software agents (e.g., Snort, Suricata, Zeek, or commercial NGFW threat engines).
* Apply baseline inspection policies, protocol anomaly detection rules, and preprocessor settings in line with internal security standards.
* Validate tap/SPAN aggregation, packet broker feeds, and interface cabling to ensure zero packet drop during traffic ingestion.
* Configure log forwarding and telemetry streaming to the central SIEM/data lake (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) via Syslog, JSON, or dedicated API connectors.

**Transition (Testing, Handover & Documentation)**

* Conduct synthetic traffic generation and controlled attack simulations (e.g., using test replay tools or benign exploit scripts) to verify detection accuracy before production cutover.
* Assist in drafting standard operating procedures (SOPs), alert escalation workflows, and initial triage playbooks for Level 1 SOC analysts.
* Document "As-Deployed" sensor architectures, IP allocation tables, tap mappings, and management interface credentials in the team knowledge base.
* Participate in maintenance window cutovers, executing pre- and post-validation checklists.

**Operations & Continuous Management**

* Monitor IDS/IPS health, disk usage, memory utilization, and inspection latency; raise service tickets for degraded hardware or dropped packets.
* Perform daily triage of IDS alerts and assist SOC teams in analyzing raw packet captures (PCAP) to distinguish true attacks from benign network anomalies.
* Execute continuous rule-tuning workflows: refine thresholds, create source/destination whitelists, and suppress verified false positives to maintain high alert fidelity.
* Schedule and apply regular signature feed updates, emergency vulnerability signatures, and minor vendor engine patches.
* Maintain metric trackers covering weekly detection counts, top triggered signatures, and tuning changes for operational reporting.
* Understanding of ITIL-based Change Management, managing end-to-end change lifecycle activities, CAB coordination, and compliant implementation of infrastructure and application changes

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of hands-on experience in network security operations, IDS/IPS administration, or SOC/tier-2 alert triage.
* **Core Technologies:** Familiarity with at least one enterprise IDS/IPS solution (commercial engines such as Palo Alto Threat Prevention, Cisco Secure IPS/Firepower, Fortinet IPS, Trend Micro TippingPoint, or open-source tools like Snort, Suricata, and Zeek).
* **Protocol & Packet Analysis:** Strong foundational grasp of the TCP/IP suite, common application protocols (HTTP/S, DNS, DHCP, TLS, SSH), and hands-on skill using packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump).
* **Signature & Rule Logic:** Basic understanding of how signature patterns, regular expressions, and protocol anomaly engines detect malicious behavior.
* **Operating Systems:** Basic to intermediate Linux command-line skills (navigating log files, viewing system resources, editing config files via vi/nano, and running basic network utilities).
* **Certifications**: Associate-level or foundational security certifications are preferred (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+, Cisco Certified CyberOps Associate, or vendor-specific associate certifications).
* **Soft Skills:** Methodical troubleshooting approach, clear technical writing for documentation, and effective cross-team communication with SOC and network infrastructure groups.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
